DESCRIPTION: Common Cloud Controls Catalog (CCC) for AWS

REQUIREMENTS_ATTRIBUTES_SECTION: CCC.Vector.CN05 Enforce Index Versioning with Rollback Protection

DESCRIPTION: Common Cloud Controls Catalog (CCC) for AWS
